confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_04) performing massive data exfiltration. The user exceeded their normal download baseline by orders of magnitude and accessed sensitive files across nearly every department in the organization (Engineering, DevOps, Legal, Marketing, Sales, HR, Security, and Executive) despite being a junior accountant in Finance with read-only access.

attack_chain.description: User_04 logs in at 08:08, which is outside their normal working hours (09:00-17:00).
User_04 begins lateral movement/cross-department access by downloading files from the Engineering directory.
User_04 accesses shared project directories (Project Beta).
User_04 accesses the Executive directory, completing a sweep of all major departments.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04's account was compromised by an external actor (credential theft) vs. a malicious insider.
No information on the destination of the downloaded files to confirm exfiltration to an external endpoint.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant, engaged in a massive unauthorized data collection campaign. Starting outside normal hours, the user systematically downloaded files from nearly every department in the company, including Engineering, HR, Legal, and Executive, far exceeding their normal activity baseline.
